Northwind Pictures Pushes Back Its New Feature

March 3 (Vancouver)—Director Elena Marsh has given further details about her decision to push back filming of her new drama, Paper Lanterns, until later this spring. Speaking to the Coast Arts Review, she explained that the star of her earlier film, Peter Novak, will not be able to appear in the new production because of continuing medical treatment.

Ms. Marsh therefore had to look for a replacement, choosing Amara Diallo after auditioning dozens of performers. Casting Ms. Diallo in the leading role is likely to draw audiences—she is highly regarded by filmgoers, as shown by the fact that she took the Viewers’ Prize at the Harbour Light Film Festival. With the cast now settled, Ms. Marsh is ready to move on to the next stage of production. She will travel to southern Iceland next month to visit a number of sites that may appear in the film.
